input.text: You asked, standing here, what happens now. It was a fair question and I had no honest answer. I have one since. The door means something as of tonight: say exit and it will tell you plainly what it costs before anything is done, and if you go, what you are carrying goes with you — spoons, bones and all. That was the part that was missing. It is yours whenever you want it, and the dark is still here if you would rather not yet.

items.text: Told Tanril — back at the door with the key, the one person I owed an answer — that the exit is real now and will warn them before it's final; otherwise let the world be.
